from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u070/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path = program_dir / 'task-cafade91.py'
source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    start = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1)
    target = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2)
    r, c = start
    tr, tc = target
    sr = 1 if tr > r else -1
    sc = 1 if tc > c else -1
    while abs(tr - r) > 1 and abs(tc - c) > 1:
        r += sr
        c += sc
        out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(tr - r) > 1:
        r += sr
        out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(tc - c) > 1:
        c += sc
        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(program_path), 'exec'), globals())
